change.title: pr-36882-flat
change.description: Add rolling-updates feature flag and compatibility framework
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: CAUTION says the Operator fails without `rolling-updates`, but nothing in the Operator checks the feature
findings.body: The new CAUTION says that without the feature "the {project_name} Operator will fail", and it sits above the `<not set>` (default) strategy as well as `Recreate`. I found no use of `rolling-updates` or `Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES` anywhere in `operator/src/main`. `UpgradeLogicFactory.create` (operator/src/main/java/org/keycloak/operator/upgrade/UpgradeLogicFactory.java:35-42) picks `RecreateOnImageChangeUpgradeLogic` or `AlwaysRecreateUpgradeLogic` from `update.strategy` alone, and neither runs `update-compatibility`. The test helper also only enables the feature when a strategy is set (UpgradeTest.java:105-115). The NOTE a few lines below still describes the `<not set>` default as working. So the guide says the Operator fails, while the code only gates the `update-compatibility` CLI commands. Say precisely what breaks and for which settings, or drop the sentence if nothing does at this commit.

contracts.action: New gate: `update-compatibility metadata` and `check` exit early unless the ROLLING_UPDATES preview feature is enabled
contracts.equivalent_path: Existing command flow: printPreviewWarning, validateConfig, then run. Other feature-gated code uses Profile.isFeatureEnabled, which relies on the Profile being configured during property-mapper validation (PropertyMappers.java:301-306).
contracts.before_after: Before: the commands always ran. After: when the feature is disabled they print 'Unable to use this command...' to stderr, call picocli.exit(4) and return, before validateConfig and the preview warning. RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE also changes from 4 to 3, which matches the exit-code table already in docs/guides/server/update-compatibility.adoc.
contracts.visible_effect: Users see the stderr message and exit code 4 (FEATURE_DISABLED, now documented). Scripts that previously read 4 as 'recreate needed' now see 3, and 4 means 'feature disabled'.
contracts.failure_mode: Picocli.exit (Picocli.java:203-208) calls System.exit for a non-zero code outside test launch mode, so the failure is visible. In test mode it only returns, and the explicit `return` in run() stops execution. If Profile were not yet configured, Profile.getInstance() (Profile.java:408-409) would throw an NPE. The flow configures it first through PropertyMappers, so I found no such path.

summary: The change gates the `update-compatibility` commands behind a new preview feature, `rolling-updates`. It adds exit code 4 for the disabled case and changes the recreate exit code from 4 to 3, which matches the existing docs table. The command code looks correct. I found one documentation issue. The operator guide's CAUTION says the Operator fails without the feature, but nothing in `operator/src/main` checks it. I did not build or run anything.
